rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday verb for predicting or expecting a future situation or event.

example.english: I foresee that it will rain tomorrow.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jyu6 gai3 ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5

rows.note: Use this colloquially when stressing that someone managed to guess or anticipate what would happen.

example.english: You really did foresee that he would stand us up.
example.traditional: 你真係估到佢會放飛機喎。
example.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 gu2 dou3 keoi5 wui5 fong3 fei1 gei1 wo3

rows.note: Use this mainly in formal or written contexts for envisioning future consequences, trends, or developments.

example.english: We can foresee that this policy will have far-reaching effects.
example.traditional: 我哋可以預見呢項政策會帶來深遠影響。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 jyu6 gin3 ne1 hong6 zing3 caak3 wui5 daai3 loi4 sam1 jyun5 jing2 hoeng2
